read_clipboard: read clipboard text and parse it into a pandas DataFrame using read_clipboard
to_clipboard_dataframe: copy a pandas DataFrame to the system clipboard in Excel-compatible tab-separated format
read_clipboard_excel: read clipboard content copied from Excel into a pandas DataFrame with tab separator
to_clipboard_string: convert an object to its string representation and write it to the system clipboard
read_clipboard_custom_sep: read clipboard text into a DataFrame with a custom separator and dtype_backend specification
